test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart shows the percentage-wise break up of students in terms of specialisation in Engineering.

Total number of students = 8000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1fb09a0b68cfbeb6c548ead556fa4a5eb1a1296cb18571a05d07f419ec073e.png] 

What is the ratio of the total number of students having either Networking or Graphics as their specialisations to the number of students having C programming as their specialisation?
solution:
Calculation:

Let the Number of students having Graphics be **G,**

Number of students having Graphics(G) = (12)/(100)times 8000

Let the Number of students having Networking be **N,**

Number of students having Networking(N) = (19)/(100)times 8000

Let the Number of students having C programming be **C,**

Number of students having C programming= (17)/(100)times 8000

The ratio of the total number of students having either Networking or Graphics as their specialisations to the number of students having C programming will be **(N + G) : C**

N+G:C=((frac{12)/(100) times 8000)+((19)/(100)×8000)}{((17)/(100)×8000)}

Reducing the (8000)/(100) from both the numerator and denominator then,

(N + G) : C = (12+19)/(17)

⇒ (N + G) : C = 31 : 17

**The ratio of students having either Networking or graphics to the number of students having C programming is 31 : 17**
